prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: how do I contact from Aruba?
Delta: Hi, Nate. Please DM your confirmation number and details so I may further assist you. Thanks! *TJF https://t.co/6iDGBJAc2m

Customer: who do I need to contact about an erroneous error on my 12status account?
Delta: Is this in regard to your SkyMiles account? *AJY

Customer: Hey Delta, I need your help booking seats on a particular flight. Would you be able to help? Cheers!
Delta: Sure, I will be glad to take a look. Pls follow/DM the confirmation number. *HRO

Customer: who do I contact when I'm unhappy with your response to a complaint?
Delta: Hi, Brook. I'm sorry for the inconvenience. You can reach out to our Customer Service team at 800-455-2720 or click on link here https://t.co/fPLXqvqlxY *TJH

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: general_question):
"""Hello who do I contact to find out about a particular crew , commendation?"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: Hi! Please DM us with the details of your request so we can look into it and help you further.
